task: Bounded original plate audit for three inscribed metal tools

publication.author: E.J.H. Mackay
publication.title: Further Excavations at Mohenjo-daro, volume II: Plates
publication.date_note: Archive metadata dates volume II1937; paired volume I text is1938. Title-page date not newly visually checked.

protocol.prior_exposure: Counts and later candidate readings known before this review; no blinded or held-out reading test.
protocol.primary_authentication: Visual count of drawn marks on original plate CXXVI. Contents pageviii independently identifies CXXVI as drawings and CXXXI as photographs.
protocol.orientation: Directions refer to displayed plate; no reading-direction claim.
protocol.notation: u,i,t are local graphic labels only; not universal sign identities or semantic units.
protocol.image_processing: Lossless crops of downloaded page JPGs, no tracing/AI redrawing/sharpening used.

records.identity_status: Plate/item join to original p454 mass and p489 catalogue; field-number blur documented in original-record audit.

target_group.arrangement: Four transverse strokes in slanted strip above five upright strokes in a horizontal strip; one arch below. Other complex signs appear farther up the same face.
target_group.confidence: Counts visually supported in published drawing; physical incisions not independently recounted from photograph.

records.other_face: Five separated complex/simple glyph locations on right depiction; not assigned M/W/P IDs in this audit.

records.identity_status: Primary plate/item and field-number join in original-record audit.

target_group.local_notation: 6i only under an explicit extraction convention
target_group.arrangement: Five strokes roughly in one row, plus a lower offset stroke at left. A complex angular sign immediately follows within the same light strip. A staff-like sign and an oval sign are elsewhere on the depicted face.
target_group.confidence: Six drawn strokes supported; separation into a standalone numerical expression not established.

records.conventional_identifier: DK7835 in Pettersson; primary catalogue DK7535
records.identity_status: Primary printed7535 versus later7835 discrepancy unresolved; joined through plate/item, not normalized number.

target_group.arrangement: Six upright strokes in a short horizontal strip above a vertical column of seven arches. Other face has a separate group of complex signs.
target_group.confidence: Counts visually supported in published drawing; arithmetic value and purpose unknown.

photo_review.observations: Photographed surfaces are corroded and uneven; reproduction does not allow an independent reliable stroke-by-stroke recount of all three target groups. Item36 visibly bears a column of curved marks, but exact count is not promoted to a new photographic verification.

tentative_correspondences.status: Visual comparison only; no explicit one-to-one printed cross-reference authenticated here.

photo_review.not_established: Photographs and drawings are not independent objects or independent semantic anchors.

conclusions: Published primary drawings support the graphic count patterns used in later metal-tool equations.
Smallaxe stroke extraction is conditional because another sign adjoins the group and one stroke is offset.
The distinction between transverse and upright tang strokes is visible but their equal or unequal numerical value is unknown.
No phonetic reading, decimal value, mass unit, whole-tool-mass interpretation, or universal code equivalence follows.
